description: KNaSe crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. K¹⁺ is bonded to five equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form distorted KSe₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with eight equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent KSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with six equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent KSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. There is one shorter (3.31 Å) and four longer (3.44 Å) K-Se bond lengths. Na¹⁺ is bonded to four equivalent Se²⁻ atoms to form NaSe₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent KSe₅ trigonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent NaSe₄ tetrahedra, and edges with six equivalent KSe₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.92-2.97 Å. Se²⁻ is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to five equivalent K¹⁺ and four equivalent Na¹⁺ atoms.
